next.reason: 1985 only makes the indexed BLOCK CONTAINS clause the sequential one. In 2023 the sequential FD (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR5 'Format 1 is the file description entry for a sequential file') and the indexed FD (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7 'Format 2 is the file description entry for a relative file or an indexed file') carry the identical BLOCK CONTAINS clause, defined once in 13.18.10 with no organization-specific rule. CHARACTERS becoming optional affects both alike.
